ReasoningLadder.note: The composer reasoning-effort control on its composer-background pill: bars plus the derived level label, inside a titled panel. Stateful — clicking steps and wraps.

EveryLevel.note: currentIndex 0/1/2 side by side: the lit-vs-dimmed bar count changes per row and the derived label follows (low/medium/high). The axis genuinely varies.

Emphasis.note: none / max / ultra at the top level. none stays neutral ink; max and ultra both take the tinted treatment (ultra additionally carries the continuous wave animation, which a still frame cannot show — captured mid-wave here).

LadderLengths.note: 2-, 3- and 5-bar ladders — bar width and gap are recomputed per ladder length, and that geometry change is visible across the three rows.

IconOnly.note: iconOnly drops the label to a 28px square; five ladders in one composer control row show the level and emphasis range at the real product density.
